This reference is for developers who read workspaces through the Coder Representational State Transfer (REST) API.
It lists the related data that the `include_related` query parameter selects and the response fields that each selection returns.

The following endpoints accept `include_related`:

- `GET /api/v2/workspaces/{workspace}`
- `GET /api/v2/users/{user}/workspace/{workspacename}`

For the full request and response schema of each endpoint, refer to the [Workspaces API reference](./api/workspaces.md).
In the Go SDK, pass a `wsrelated.Config` as the `IncludeRelated` field of `codersdk.WorkspaceOptions`.

## Select related data

Select only the related data you read, because loading less related data makes the request cheaper.
The value of `include_related` is a comma-separated list of paths, such as `template,latest_build.resources.agents`.
Each path is one of the following:

- `latest_build`
- `latest_build.job`
- `latest_build.job.queue_position`
- `latest_build.resources`
- `latest_build.resources.agents`
- `latest_build.resources.agents.apps`
- `latest_build.resources.agents.apps.statuses`
- `latest_build.resources.agents.log_sources`
- `latest_build.resources.agents.scripts`
- `latest_build.resources.metadata`
- `latest_build.template_version`
- `template`

The parameter follows these rules:

- Omit `include_related` to return all related data.
- Pass an empty value, `include_related=`, to return only the fields that are always returned.
- Selecting a path also selects its ancestors.
  For example, `latest_build.job` also selects `latest_build`.
- End a path with `.*` to select it and every path below it, or pass `*` to select everything.

An unknown path, an empty entry such as `template,,latest_build`, or a `*` before the end of a path returns `400 Bad Request`.

The following request returns the workspace with its template data and its latest build, including the build's resources and agents:

```shell
curl "https://coder.example.com/api/v2/workspaces/<workspace-id>?include_related=template,latest_build.resources.agents" \
  -H "Coder-Session-Token: <your-token>"
```

## Fields that aren't selected

A field that needs related data you didn't select doesn't hold a meaningful value, so don't read it.
Most of these fields are returned with zero values, such as `null`, an empty string, `0`, `false`, or a zero ID.
Fields that Coder computes from related data, such as `health`, `outdated`, and `latest_build.status`, can hold values computed from the missing data.
For example, without `latest_build.resources.agents`, `health.healthy` is `true` even when an agent is unhealthy.
